package nats

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func validDialogTeacherContextMutation() []byte {
	return []byte(`{
  "schema_version":1,
  "event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "event_type":"dialog.teacher.context-mutated",
  "occurred_at":"2026-09-04T12:00:00.123456Z",
  "dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  "event_sequence":61,
  "student_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  "personal_teacher_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
  "context_type":"lesson",
  "context_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
  "message_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
  "message_sequence":7,
  "message_version":2,
  "last_event_sequence":61,
  "mutation":"updated"
}`)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherContextMutatedStrictBodyFreeContract(t *testing.T) {
	mutation, err := DecodeDialogTeacherContextMutated(validDialogTeacherContextMutation())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.SubjectDialogTeacherContextMutated, mutation.EventType)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextLesson, mutation.ContextType)
	require.Equal(t, int64(7), mutation.MessageSequence)
	require.Equal(t, 2, mutation.MessageVersion)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated, mutation.Mutation)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherContextMutatedAcceptsDeleteAndGeneralBinding(t *testing.T) {
	payload := bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"context_type":"lesson",
  "context_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",`), []byte(`"context_type":"general_teacher",`), 1)
	payload = bytes.Replace(payload, []byte(`"mutation":"updated"`), []byte(`"mutation":"deleted"`), 1)
	mutation, err := DecodeDialogTeacherContextMutated(payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextGeneral, mutation.ContextType)
	require.Empty(t, mutation.ContextID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationDeleted, mutation.Mutation)
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherContextMutatedRejectsUnknownContentAndInvalidShape(t *testing.T) {
	tests := map[string][]byte{
		"body":                 bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"mutation":"updated"`), []byte(`"body":"private","mutation":"updated"`), 1),
		"schema":               bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"schema_version":1`), []byte(`"schema_version":2`), 1),
		"event type":           bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"dialog.teacher.context-mutated"`), []byte(`"dialog.message.updated"`), 1),
		"sequence":             bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"last_event_sequence":61`), []byte(`"last_event_sequence":60`), 1),
		"version":              bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"message_version":2`), []byte(`"message_version":0`), 1),
		"mutation":             bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"mutation":"updated"`), []byte(`"mutation":"edited"`), 1),
		"general with context": bytes.Replace(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), []byte(`"context_type":"lesson"`), []byte(`"context_type":"general_teacher"`), 1),
	}
	for name, payload := range tests {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := DecodeDialogTeacherContextMutated(payload)
			require.Error(t, err)
		})
	}
}

func TestDecodeDialogTeacherContextMutatedRejectsOversizedPayload(t *testing.T) {
	payload := append(validDialogTeacherContextMutation(), bytes.Repeat([]byte(" "), 4096)...)
	_, err := DecodeDialogTeacherContextMutated(payload)
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDialogTeacherContextMutationErrorStrategy(t *testing.T) {
	require.True(t, terminateDialogTeacherContextMutation(domain.ErrInvalidDialogTeacherContextMutation))
	require.True(t, terminateDialogTeacherContextMutation(domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict))
	require.False(t, terminateDialogTeacherContextMutation(errors.New("postgres unavailable")))
}
